content.short: Ghostchain NFT Club (GCNFTC) is a CNFT project with a mission of turning Cardano FUD into FUN.
content.description: Ghostchain NFT Club is a collection of 10,000 unique CNFTs that are made up of over 1,000 exciting traits that tells the story of Cardano like it has never been told before. We are not a copy cat version of a successful NFT project on another ecosystem (“the this of Cardano”). Built by members of the Cardano community, for the Cardano community, our mission is to change the negative stigma around the term “Ghostchain”; making it about something FUN and EXCITING.
content.meta: Find out about Ghostchain NFT Club (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
